desc:
It's Super Slime Simulator! Consume everything in your path as you grow larger and larger! You can even customize your slime and deck it out with hundreds of items!

👍 - Please consider giving us a thumbs up and a favorite, it's a free way to help support us! You can also follow the game to be one of the first to get notified when updates go live!

MOST RECENT UPDATE:
